Though imported by the Ironforge expedition to blast through ancient stone, the exiled tauren Gann Stonespire seeks to reclaim it to assemble an explosive charge against the invaders.

The Bael'dun expedition tore into the ancestral lands of the Stonespire tribe armed with heavy earthmovers and blasting reagents. To crack open the stubborn rockbeds of the southern Barrens, the dwarves relied on volatile chemical compounds. Sodium Nitrate forms a crucial stabilizing and oxidizing agent in high-grade explosives, carried routinely by Bael'dun riflemen, soldiers, and officers inside the excavation works and nearby fortress.

Following the devastation of his tribe's homeland, Gann Stonespire observed the invaders closely and scavenged their engineering schematics. Recognizing that conventional attacks could not easily breach the heavily defended keep, Gann plotted to turn the dwarves' industrial blasting supplies against them. By mixing looted Sodium Nitrate with nitroglycerin and wood pulp, the tauren exile fashions makeshift charges designed to shake the foundations of Bael Modan.

The Ironforge dwarves use it as a chemical component for explosives to blast away the rocky terrain of their dig site. Gann Stonespire intends to combine it with nitroglycerin and wood pulp to create powerful demolition charges to strike back at the Bael Modan keep.

Solomon's Plea to Darkshire is an urgent missive penned by Magistrate Solomon of Lakeshire addressed to Lord Ello Ebonlocke. In the face of mounting Blackrock orc and gnoll threats, the letter begs the leadership of Darkshire to send their elite militia, the Night Watch, to bolster Lakeshire's strained defenses.

Lakeshire stands on the brink of being overwhelmed by invading Blackrock orcs, gnolls, and murlocs, with virtually no official reinforcements arriving from Stormwind. In desperation, Magistrate Solomon drafted this formal plea to Mayor Ello Ebonlocke of Darkshire, petitioning him to dispatch members of the Night Watch northward into Redridge. The document reflects the severe breakdown of central military support across southern Azeroth, forcing individual human settlements to look to one another for mutual survival.

While Solomon's request is urgent, it underscores Lakeshire's isolation from the true horrors gripping its neighbors. Duskwood itself is besieged by undead, ravenous beasts, and pervasive darkness, leaving the Night Watch already stretched beyond its limits simply holding the village borders. Rather than discovering an untapped reserve of fresh soldiers, couriers delivering the plea find a town equally beleaguered and wholly unable to spare defenders for Redridge.
